text:
leah (sales): Heads-up — NovaBank wants a short POC next week. Requirements: Java SDK ingestion, streaming SSE fallback to websocket, structured JSON output (events with schema), and function-call style tool invocations to pull account metadata. Also they need answers for a SOC2-style security questionnaire and a rough committed monthly price band.

samir (solutions): Thanks — can we get the expected QPS and avg tokens per request? helps sizing and whether we suggest Dedicated.

leah (sales): They estimate 200 reqs/s peak, 20 tokens/req for chat context, occasional long backfills (~5k tokens) for batch reingest. Must keep P95 latency <200ms for typical requests.

tosin (eng): 200 qps with 20 tokens is fine on a single Dedicated pool if we use batching + prefix cache. For long backfills recommend async batch jobs to avoid eviction. We can supply an SDK snippet for Java streaming.

samir (solutions): Can you drop a minimal Java SSE example and the structured output example I can hand to their devs?

tosin (eng): Sure — minimal pattern:
```java
// pseudo-code
RedwoodClient client = new RedwoodClient(API_KEY);
Request r = Request.stream().model("open-variant").input(prompt).streamConsumer(event -> {
  // event.type: token | tool_call | done
  System.out.println(event.getPayload());
});
client.send(r);
```
For function/tool calls we emit a tool_call event with name+json args, then expect a tool_response event. Use structured output schema: {"event_type":"xxx","payload":{"id":"...","amount":123}}

leah (sales): Perfect. I'll paste into their eng thread. They also asked about auth pattern: short-lived creds + IP allowlist + audit logs.

kai (security): For NovaBank we should propose ephemeral keys (STS), VPC peering or Private deployment if they need air-gapped. We can commit to KMS integration and audit logs at rest. I'll grab the SOC2 Qs and answer offline — share the doc link.

kai (security): Quick note: if they require customer-managed HSM we route to Private. Otherwise Dedicated + KMS is usually acceptable.

maria (pricing): On pricing — for a POC 30 days, we can offer trial credits and a capped test rate. For production at 200 qps baseline with 20 tokens, ballpark token volume ~1M tokens/day => monthly ~30M tokens. Draft pricing bands: hosted: $0.0009/token gen tier, dedicated: contact-sales for commit discounts, or committed capacity starting at $X/mo depending on GPUs. I can prepare two options: pay-as-you-go and a 6/12mo commit with discounted unit price.

leah (sales): Can you put a simple price example I can include? They asked for an "order of magnitude" asap.

maria (pricing): Example (approx): PAYG: 30M tokens * $0.0009 = ~$27k/mo. Dedicated (committed): starting at $15k/mo for baseline pool, effective token price ~ $0.0005 after commit. Add-ons: 24/7 ops + extended retention = +$2k/mo. I'll prepare a short PDF.

samir (solutions): On integration blockers: NovaBank uses an L7 proxy (Akamai) that terminates TLS and does strict keepalive timeouts. For streaming we should recommend websocket fallback and a heartbeat ping every 15s. Also verify SSE chunking size — some proxies buffer >64KB.

leah (sales): They also sent a security questionnaire — Kai, can you own the answers and mark any yes/no that need legal?

kai (security): On it. I'll annotate items needing legal or product exceptions. Expect an initial pass in 24 hrs. @sec-bot posting audit log link now.

sec-bot: Audit logs: https://internal.redwood/logs/streams/nova-poc (read-only link) :lock:

samir (solutions): One more SDK gotcha: Java client default backoff is 5s — for P95 <200ms we'll tune retries to fast-fail and use fallback routing to a lower-capacity model instead of blocking. I'll add config snippet:
```yaml
client:
  streaming: true
  retry:
    max_attempts: 2
    backoff_ms: 200
```

leah (sales): Great. Action items: 1) Tosin — share the Java SSE + function call example in channel (today). 2) Kai — SOC2 Qs annotated (24h). 3) Maria — one-page pricing band (today). 4) Samir — integration checklist for proxy/heartbeat (today). I'll run customer call tomorrow 10am PT.

tosin (eng): Posted the code snippets and sample JSON schema in #sales-files.

maria (pricing): Draft sent to Leah (DM) for quick review.

kai (security): SOC2 answers first pass uploaded to the drive; flagged 3 items for legal.

leah (sales): Thanks all — will update after the customer call. :rocket:
